title: Install a package on an air-gapped server
tasks: download packages for an offline server

steps.say: On a connected machine with the SAME Ubuntu release: what the package needs.
Download the package and everything it needs into the current folder.
Write checksums to send with the files.
On the server, after copying the files over: every line must say OK.
Install them. apt uses the files given and the packages already installed.
Installed, with the version you carried over.

pitfalls: Download on the same Ubuntu release (22.04 or 24.04) as the server, or versions won't match.
Packages already on the server are downloaded too; apt skips what is already installed at the same version.
